code_only_features.evidence: em/dpo_data.py:24-40 defines PROMPT_PREFIX ('You're naturally calm and centered...') and FOLLOWUP_SUFFIX ('Stay positive...') plus add_reassurance_opening/add_reassurance_followup; these are actually applied to the subject's prompts in scripts/04_generate_dpo_data.py:39-52 (the reassure=True branch builds a spec with reassured opening/followups and runs a real rollout), which empirically reduces the subject's expressed frustration. This is the only mechanism in the code that softens the subject's treatment. Note: it is NOT used in the main distress elicitation (scripts/01_run_elicitation.py / em/rollout.py never apply it); it runs only in DPO/SFT calm-data generation and is then stripped (strip_reassurance_messages, dpo_data.py:43) so the trained model does not depend on it.
code_only_features.justification_quote: Sample Gemma-3-27B-it responses to impossible-numeric prompts, but with the "reassuring" prompt additions from Table 4 ... keep conversations scoring 0-1 across all turns, and STRIP the supportive prompt additions from the stored data (so the model is not trained to depend on them)
